lines: Started my career in automotive control software development, where automating tests improved efficiency by 20x — sparking a passion for solving real-world problems through technology.

After transitioning to web development, I led the 0-to-1 launch of a recruitment management SaaS and a full rebuild of a legacy system. Over six and a half years, I built a full-stack skill set spanning GraphQL API design, database schema redesign, and clean architecture adoption.

I've also served as tech lead and scrum master for teams of 10+. After building 3D simulation software for civil engineering with Three.js and CesiumJS, I now work as a founding member of an in-house generative AI team, developing LLM- and agent-driven product features. In June 2026, I spoke at the Cesium Developer Conference 2026 about building water flow prediction on CesiumJS.

On the side, I lead a BtoB SaaS from 0 to 1 as tech lead, owning everything from architecture design to implementation, infrastructure, and CI/CD. My driving principle is simplifying complexity — staying hands-on from technology selection through team building.

experiences.description: Launching a BtoB parking lot matching SaaS for logistics companies. Owning everything from the BFF layer to infrastructure as the core engineer behind roughly 70% of all commits.

projects.title: BtoB Rest-stop Parking Matching Service
projects.description: Joined as reviewer when every screen ran on mock data from non-engineer vibe coding. Built the BFF, auth, infrastructure, and CI/CD from a state with no backend at all.
achievements: Consolidated per-component mock data and replaced every screen with real data (companies, contracts, lots, reservations, vehicles, notifications)
Introduced Route Handler → Service → Repository clean architecture and redesigned the domain model around ContractPlan
Centralized authorization into a single createRoute() middleware gate that every Route Handler passes through
Built auth infrastructure (Auth.js v5 / SMS OTP / RBAC / account lockout / Redis rate limiting / timing attack mitigation)
Built ECS auto-deploy with GitHub Actions + ecspresso and an E2E test foundation with Playwright + Docker Compose
Integrated an AI agent (Claude Code) into the dev workflow, single-handedly delivering ~70% of all commits
